name: Nightcrawler

abilityDetails.Dodge: Gelen bir temel saldırıdan veya temaslı özel saldırıdan geriye kaçarak kaçınma; Çeviklik ustalığı bu pencereyi genişletir.
abilityDetails.Instant Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Bleed Vulnerability: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kaçışı engelleyen ve kanamaya immün şampiyonlar kullan. Modunu değiştirmeye çalışmak riskli. Sersemletme immünitesi olan node'larda tehlike artar.
signatureAbility:
Neyaphem Heritage
Nightcrawler's Evade Chance can only be lowered by Tech Champions.
Increase the Potency of Nightcrawler's Instant Bleeds and Critical Damage Rating by [11 - 103.09]% of his Current Prowess Potency.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Dodging back and holding Block for 2 seconds, Nightcrawler will swap between Neyaphem and Swashbuckling mode.
Ending a Combo with a Light Attack or Dodging back and holding Block for 2 seconds causes Nightcrawler to swap between Neyaphem and Swashbuckling modes.
While Dodging back, Nightcrawler cannot be struck by attacks.
Whenever Nightcrawler successfully Dodges an attack this way, gain a 10% Prowess Passive for 20 seconds. Max stacks: 10.
Critical Hits inflict an instant Bleed dealing a burst of [6,042.6] Direct Damage. The potency of this Bleed is reduced by 10% for each Armor Up Buff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Neyaphem Mode
content: Nightcrawler gains a 22% chance to Evade all incoming attacks. This chance is increased by 15% against Physical Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Swashbuckling Mode
content: Second Medium Attacks grant a Precision Passive, increasing Critical Rating by +[485.29] for 15 seconds. Max stacks: 5. When activating these Precisions, pause Nightcrawler's personal Prowess and Precision effects for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Neyaphem Mode: On activation, gain a non-stacking Evasion Passive increasing the chance for Evades to trigger by 33% for 10 seconds.
Swashbuckling Mode: Gain a 10 second 100% Prowess Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Neyaphem Mode: Reduce Opponents Block Proficiency by -[2,160.71] for the duration of this Attack.
Swashbuckling Mode: Inflict the Opponent with a 15 second Bleed Vulnerability, increasing the potency of incoming Bleed effects by 50%

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a non-stacking Incinerate Passive dealing [503.55] Energy Damage over 30 seconds. While active, all of Nightcrawler's personal Bleed effects turn into Incinerates with the same potency.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Neyaphem Heritage
content: Nightcrawler's Evade Chance can only be lowered by Tech Champions.
Increase the Potency of Nightcrawler's Instant Bleeds and Critical Damage Rating by [11 - 103.09]% of his Current Prowess Potency.
